input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_report AS
WITH
null_amt AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_orders WHERE amount IS NULL),
neg_amt AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_orders WHERE amount < 0),
duplicate_oid AS (
 SELECT (COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) AS cnt FROM workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_orders
),
orphan_cust AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_orders o
 LEFT JOIN workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
),
future_od AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_orders WHERE order_date > DATE('2026-11-01')
),
invalid_status AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_orders
 WHERE status NOT IN ('new','paid','shipped','cancelled')
)
SELECT 'null_amount' AS check_name, cnt AS failing_rows FROM null_amt
UNION ALL
SELECT 'negative_amount', cnt FROM neg_amt
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate_order_id', cnt FROM duplicate_oid
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_customer', cnt FROM orphan_cust
UNION ALL
SELECT 'future_order_date', cnt FROM future_od
UNION ALL
SELECT 'invalid_status', cnt FROM invalid_status;
SELECT check_name, failing_rows FROM workspace.exam_xe7b19.dq_report ORDER BY failing_rows DESC LIMIT 1;
